title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Numbers 10: the two silver trumpets, Israel setting out from the wilderness of Sinai, Moses and Hobab, and the words spoken when the ark moved.

questions.text: What were the two trumpets Yahweh told Moses to make made of?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to make two trumpets of silver, of beaten work, for calling the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

questions.text: Who were to gather to Moses if only one trumpet was blown?
questions.explanation: If they blew just one trumpet, the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, were to gather to Moses.

answers.text: The Levites who bore the tabernacle
The princes, the heads of the thousands
The elders and officers of the people

questions.text: Which camps went forward when the first alarm was blown?
questions.explanation: When an alarm was blown, the camps on the east side went forward; at the second alarm, the camps on the south side went forward.

answers.text: The camps on the north side
The camps on the west side
The camps on the south side
The camps on the east side

questions.text: Who were to blow the trumpets?
questions.explanation: The sons of Aaron, the priests, were to blow the trumpets, as a statute forever throughout their generations.

answers.text: The sons of Aaron, the priests

questions.text: On which day was the cloud taken up from over the tabernacle in the second month of the second year?
questions.explanation: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle.

questions.text: In which wilderness did the cloud stay after Israel left the wilderness of Sinai?
questions.explanation: The children of Israel went forward out of the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

questions.text: The standard of which tribe's camp went forward first?
questions.explanation: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward, with Nahshon the son of Amminadab over its army.

questions.text: Which camp was the rear guard of all the camps?
questions.explanation: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan was the rear guard of all the camps.

questions.text: Why did Moses ask Hobab not to leave them?
questions.explanation: Moses told Hobab that he knew how they were to encamp in the wilderness, and that he could be their eyes.

answers.text: He knew how they should encamp in the wilderness
He could pay for food with his silver
He owned many camels and flocks
He could speak with the kings of Canaan

questions.text: What did Moses say when the ark went forward?
questions.explanation: When the ark went forward, Moses said, "Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!"

answers.text: "Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of Israel"
"Lead us to the place you promised"
"Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered"
"Blessed be Yahweh, who goes before us"
